Calculate the thermal-mismatch strain in a thin aluminum film bonded to a thick ceramic substrate, where the film is fully constrained by the substrate upon cooling.
Use the film thermal expansion coefficient α_f = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the substrate thermal expansion coefficient α_s = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the cooling temperature change ΔT = 180 K.
Assume the film is thin relative to the substrate so that the substrate fully constrains the film and the film strain equals the imposed mismatch strain.
Compute the thermal-mismatch strain using the formula ε = (α_f − α_s) × ΔT.
Report the result as a dimensionless strain value.
